key.name: current-task-name
key.summary: Name of the task being tracked
key.description: Empty when nothing is being tracked. On enable, a non-empty value starts a fresh session (new uuid) for the same task name — it is never a resumption of the old uuid. See TaskStore.loadState.

key.name: current-task-uuid
key.summary: UUID shared by the active session's opening and closing rows

key.name: current-task-started-at
key.summary: Unix seconds at which the active session started

key.name: current-project-slug
key.summary: Project the active task belongs to
key.description: Persists after a task completes or pauses, so it doubles as "last used project" — the task picker's default next time.

key.name: widget-x
key.summary: Saved widget X position in stage coordinates
key.description: -1 means "never positioned" — fall back to the default corner.

key.name: widget-y
key.summary: Saved widget Y position in stage coordinates
key.description: -1 means "never positioned" — fall back to the default corner.

key.name: show-widget
key.description: When off, only the top-bar indicator is shown. Tracking continues either way.

key.name: prompt-on-startup
key.summary: Ask what you are working on when the extension starts with no active task
key.description: The macOS widget opened its task picker on every launch with nothing tracked. Kept as the default here, but made optional: a Shell modal takes a keyboard grab, which is a good deal heavier at every login than the popover it is standing in for.
